# Legacy CSV importer

## Summary

This document covers the legacy CSV importer component.

The component reads row batches from three input directories,
normalizes them into a unified schema, and writes to the target store.
Two normalizers run on a per-file trigger; the third is schema-driven.

Current status: integration blocked by a type mismatch at the string adapter.
The mismatch is intermittent and not reproducible in the test bench.
